title: The Lamp Turned So Two Could Read
youtube_title: The Lamp Turned So Two Could Read | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Milo sees that a lamp that could be turned so two pages were lit will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Milo makes a smaller, even share so Kira is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
